courses.subject: SURY
courses.title: Research
courses.description: To conduct laboratory-based or clinical research work on the assigned research topic.
courses.learning_outcomes: The programme is research-oriented. Students should show ability for independent work and inform themselves in depth about the fields of knowledge relevant to the topic of their projects. Students will be required to submit a research thesis and pass an oral examination for graduation.
courses.course_syllabus: To be recommended by Supervisor / Co-Supervisor.
courses.feedback_evaluation: Direct feedback from student to Supervisor / Co-Supervisor.
courses.recommended_readings: The reading materials to be recommended by Supervisor / Co-Supervisor.
